'''Tefani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] member of the [[Second Battalion (Republic Medical Corps)|Second Battalion]] of the [[Republic Medical Corps]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. More commonly known as the "Protectors", this humanitarian division served alongside the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], conducting rescue, reconnaissance, and evacuation operations to help civilians who were caught in the crossfire. In [[3638 BBY]] Tefani along with the rest of the Battalion was deployed on the disaster-stricken [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]], where he and [[Cash Zarrin]] worked on evacuating civilians from the groundquake-hit [[Talaos City]], asking a Republic agent on the planet to clear out the [[InterStellar Regulators]] to allow the Protectors to do their job. When a group of workers refused to leave, believing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts's]] lies about the nature of groundquakes, Tefani had to personally convince them to evacuate before their house was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tefani appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, released on [[April 9]], [[2013]]. Cut content in the game files indicates that he was originally involved in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class story missions (also cut) on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] and [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]].
